en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Mansour Bin Al Abbas, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Bin Yaqteen, from Hashim Bin Khalid, from Nuaym Al Basry, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘
The habitual (drinker of) the wine is the one who, whenever he finds it, drinks it’.
en.sarwar: 3. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Mansur ibn al-‘Abbas from Ali ibn Yaqtin from Hashim ibn Khalid from Nu’aym al-Basriy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
A wine addict is one who drinks whenever he finds.’”
